NS-1 is an objective GPS test, not a test of when the rider complained; the rider's 22:38 message does not cure the driver's failure to be within the pickup radius [F10][F5][F1][NS-1].

A clean driver profile cannot substitute for the GPS conditions NS-1 requires, and profile facts may never decide the case on their own [F17][NS-1].
